summary: Known as Primo; married Genevieve Schwab in 1937 and lived in the Petriello family house on Bunker Hill Street in Scranton; John's great-granduncle.
bio:
Nicholas Michael Petriello, known in the family as Primo, was born on 25 August 1913. He married Genevieve Schwab in 1937, and in April 1940 the couple and their baby daughter Grace were renting a unit in the family house at 1028 Bunker Hill Street in Scranton. Family records say he was in military service in 1945, which is probable but not confirmed.

When his sister Josephine Castellano died in November 1995 he was named among her surviving brothers as Nick Petrillo. He died on 12 August 2000 and was buried at St. Mary of Mount Carmel in Dunmore. He was John's great-granduncle.
